name: starry-chinese-checkers
description: 星際彈珠中國跳棋 — 多人線上中國跳棋（React + Socket.IO，無資料庫）

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
